Layer.OnCommand:
%function(self)
self:hibernate( Hib or 0 ) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X-80) self:y(SCREEN_BOTTOM+50) self:zoom(2) self:SetTextureFiltering(false) self:effectperiod(2) self:diffusealpha(0.5) self:playcommand('TweenStart') end
Layer.TweenStartCommand: %function(self) if LimitX == nil then self:x(math.random( SCREEN_LEFT, SCREEN_RIGHT ) ) else self:x(math.random( LimitX[1] or SCREEN_LEFT, LimitX[2] or SCREEN_RIGHT ) ) end self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.8) self:addy(-50) self:sleep(0.01) self:addy(600) self:queuecommand('TweenStart') end
